disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder participants from ABIDE-I (discovery/primary) and ABIDE-II (replication). ABIDE datasets use DSM-IV-TR / DSM-5 criteria for ASD diagnosis (criteria not re-stated in this paper).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "we investigated the maturational abnormalities in the cortical hierarchy among individuals with ASD." "Two large-scale independent datasets from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE), termed the ABIDE I and II, were analyzed."

dataset-of-origin.detail: ABIDE-I used as primary/discovery dataset; ABIDE-II used as replication dataset. Both are large-scale multi-site rs-fMRI datasets.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Two large-scale independent datasets from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE), termed the ABIDE I and II, were analyzed." "We utilized ABIDE-I data for the primary normative modeling analyses, and the reproducibility was assessed using ABIDE-II data"

age.detail: Combined statistics for ABIDE-I ASD (n=333, mean=13.91, SD=3.58) and ABIDE-II ASD (n=302, mean=11.93, SD=4.01). Weighted mean = (333×13.91 + 302×11.93) / 635 = 12.97 years. Pooled SD = sqrt((332×3.58² + 301×4.01²) / 633) = 3.79 years. Min=5 and max=22 inferred from abstract stating 'aged 5-22 years' for the three combined datasets and from the age-bin analysis (childhood: 5–12, early adolescence: 12–15, adolescents and young adults: 15–22 years).
